column3: “your lifeblood” renders “your blood of your lives,” and “from every man's brother” renders “from the hand of each man his brother.”
“By man” may also be rendered “for that man.”
“Populate the earth abundantly” renders “swarm on the earth.”
“for all successive generations” renders “for everlasting generations.”
“began farming” renders “Noah, a man of the ground, began.”
“his servant” renders “a servant to them” (also in verse 27).
